supportedFixes: Preserve every node, relationship, and label. This 1074x708 canvas (ratio 1.52) declares no intrinsic-height fit and is below the 1.55 wide ratio, so the desktop Reader can neither narrow it nor accept vertical scroll: it renders 887px tall at the full 1346px width and the page reaches 1013px before cards against 900px, a certain visual-check failure. Either compact vertical spacing so meta.viewBox height is at most 692 at this width, or spread content sideways so the width is at least 1098 at this height; for architecture, omitting meta.viewBox lets the renderer size the canvas and declare the fit.
